criteria.statusReadyMeans: Configuration is ready; it does not certify post-upgrade host execution.
runtimeReceiptVerification: A product/root-matched, unexpired probe is required.
A matching real event and session identity are required.
Latest event processRuntime is read from its actual-process observation; terminal runtime cannot fill it.
maintenanceFinalizeRequires: Selected adapter evidence contains sessionId, observedAt, and artifact.
observedAt must be at or after this final proposal appliedAt and not in the future.
Existing artifact JSON must have schemaVersion 2 and matching product, sessionId, and harnessRoot.
criteria.entryHashLimit: Current VerificationEvent schema does not emit entryHash, and current finalize criteria do not require entryHash or processRuntime. Current distribution hashes prove installed bytes only, not which bytes a real host executed.
